summary: The footage shows major roof damage with a large opening, water damage to the living-room ceiling, shattered front windows and minor damage to belongings. A power line appears to be hanging low across the driveway, so treat it as live. The illustrative repair estimate in this report uses an assumed home size and is not a quote. Check the declarations section to see whether federal Individual Assistance is available in your county.
recommendedActions: If you are in immediate danger, call 911.
Stay away from the low-hanging power line and report it to your utility.
Cover the roof opening with a tarp only if it is safe to do so.
Photograph every room before cleaning up.
Contact your insurer to open a claim and keep receipts for temporary repairs.
